logicTokens.aliases: P-Switches; PSwitch; P-Switch; TrampleSwitchTimer; CapSwitchTimer; HipDropSwitchTimer
logicTokens.notes: Pressing a timer switch (TrampleSwitchTimer/CapSwitchTimer/HipDropSwitchTimer): the press itself is refused until owned. Also grows the Wooded Kingdom flower roads (RailCollision) and keeps the Lost Kingdom poison pillars up, since switches start both.

logicTokens.aliases: Cappy Flowers; CapFlower; CapFlowerGroup; Flower Path
logicTokens.notes: Cappy flower paths (CapFlowerGroup): without it the path wilts the frame it starts, so any moon that needs the whole path in bloom needs this.

Timed scarecrows (CapRack placed as CapRackTimer), in sub-areas too: the timer expires the frame it starts. Also grows the Snow Kingdom Wintery Flower Road, which scarecrows start. A sub-area scarecrow moon needs this and the sub-area key.
Note runs (NoteObjDirector): without it the notes vanish the frame the run starts. Every Taking Notes moon needs this.

logicTokens.aliases: Wallet; Coins; Yellow Coins; Gold Coins
logicTokens.notes: Carrying yellow coins (Bonus Abilities, opt-in). Without it no yellow coin can be picked up, so nothing can be bought on a gold-coin Crazy Cap shelf: every Shopping in ... moon needs this, and so does every key sold there, since a shelf reuses its shop moon's requirement.

Travelling through warp paintings (Bonus Abilities, opt-in). Without it no painting can be entered (unlocked ones still show their art). Do not name it in requirements: MoonRando applies it to every painting link (expandStageAccessFromPaintings).

logicTokens.aliases: Odyssey Travel; Odyssey; Globe; Kingdom Travel
logicTokens.notes: Handing in moons and flying the Odyssey (Bonus Abilities, opt-in). Without it Cappy catches on the globe but nothing happens, and only Return to Start leads home. Do not name it in requirements: MoonRando applies it to every kingdom the Odyssey opens (unlockKingdom).
Held while any one of Neutral, Up, Down or Spin Throw is unlocked.
